title: Warm Smoky British Quinoa Welsh Rarebit
description: A smoky and springy Welsh-inspired dish featuring quinoa and a lacquer glaze, perfect for a halal-friendly meal prep option. This dish combines the flavors of Britain with the nutritional benefits of quinoa.
instructions: Rinse the quinoa in a fine mesh strainer and drain well.
In a medium saucepan, bring the quinoa and water to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for 15 minutes.
In a small saucepan, melt the butter over medium heat.
Add the smoked paprika, lacquer glaze, salt, and black pepper to the saucepan and stir to combine.
Add the shredded cheddar cheese to the saucepan and stir until melted and smooth.
Fluff the cooked quinoa with a fork and stir in the cheese mixture.
Serve the quinoa hot, garnished with additional smoked paprika if desired.
